drhp.business: Provides outsourced customer experience (CX) services to enterprises under multi-year contracts. Revenue is recognised per handled interaction through per-minute, FTE, per-transaction, or outcome-based pricing. Key service lines: customer acquisition, customer service, order fulfilment, payment and collections, customer retention, technical support, and digital solutions. Verticals served: Telecom & Utilities (the largest revenue vertical in Q1 FY2027), HTT, BFSI, Retail, and Healthcare. Operates 40 delivery centres in 13 countries and supports 28 languages. Has grown partly through acquisitions (Ameridial, Boomsourcing, ACG, Sequential Technology, others). April–March fiscal year.

overview.business_overview:
We are a customer experience (“CX”) service provider delivering services across multiple channels, including voice, email, chat, social media and message, in a cost-effective manner with technology playing a central role in our service delivery model, in addition to providing AI Data Infrastructure Services that include data collection, data annotation and labelling, and teleoperations services. (Source: Everest Report, "Industry Overview" on page 171) With a human and tech philosophy at its core, Fusion CX blends deep domain expertise with a portfolio of proprietary AI tools to enable intelligent, multilingual, and omnichannel engagement at scale through a broad spectrum of generative AI-driven technologies that enhance customer engagement, operational efficiency, and digital transformation (Source: Everest Report, "Industry Overview" on page 171) Our business process solutions and services company maintains focus on key verticals, including telecom and utilities, healthcare and life sciences, (HTT), BFSI, and retail, where it has developed deep domain specialization. (Source: Everest Report, "Industry Overview" on page 171) We have a track record of acquiring and integrating companies in the CX space and a portion of our growth has come from such acquisitions. Our acquisitions have also contributed to the growth of our portfolio of services and customers. We have developed a multilingual global network with 40 delivery centers and two sales offices spread across 13 countries as on June 30, 2026.

While traditional BPO focuses on cost efficiency and back-office operations, CX emphasizes end-to-end engagement, personalization, and value creation, making it a more strategic and future-ready service offering. (Source: Everest Report, "Industry Overview" on page 146) Approaching opportunities through a CX-focused lens rather than a traditional BPO approach has enabled us to secure business from larger customers including 22 Fortune 1000 companies out of a total of 208 customers as on June 30, 2026. Some of our key customers include DMEC Capital Services, Park West, Telaid, Achieve Collection, Ameriflex, Coastline, Ajio, Meesho, Call Core Media, Arvind Fashion, Propneu S.A., Leonardo Hotels, Insurance Express, K2 ClaimsServices Sentry Credit, and Traya. Our flexible commercial structures, including fixed-fee, transaction-based, and outcome-based models, allow customers to choose the option that best suits their specific needs and industry requirements.

We deliver end-to-end customer experience solutions through platforms and AI-powered tools developed in-house. Our tailored delivery model enables measurable impact across customer satisfaction, operational efficiency, and cost optimization. Driving our technology-led transformation is our Subsidiary, Omind Technologies Inc and its subsidiary, Omind Technologies Private Limited (together, “Omind”), which is developing proprietary platforms across marketing AI, conversational AI, quality automation and workforce management. Omind is central to our evolution from a traditional CX service provider into a productized, SaaS-enabled CX service provider.

For further details of acquisitions undertaken by us, please see “History and Certain Corporate Matters – Details regarding material acquisitions or divestments of business/undertakings, mergers, amalgamations, and revaluation of assets, if any, in the last ten years – Acquisitions, mergers, and amalgamations by our Company” on page 240.

Through a combination of organic and inorganic growth by way of strategic acquisitions, we have built a multilingual, global delivery network which is scalable.

As on June 30, 2026, we operate in 13 countries with 40 strategically located delivery centres, ensuring 24x7 support across several time zones. We provide support in 28 languages including English, French, Spanish, Portuguese, German, Arabic, Mandarin, Italian and Hindi.

Our delivery centres in North America cater to local markets, while Latin America provides cultural alignment and time zone proximity to North America. Additionally, our delivery centres in India and the Philippines deliver cost-effective, round-the-clock support. Our Company had 13,735 CX Employees and 3,829 Field Workforce assisting on operational tasks in our telecom and other utilities sector as on June 30, 2026.

Our Promoters, Pankaj Dhanuka and Kishore Saraogi co-founded our Company in 2004 and bring over 22 years and 27 years of expertise, respectively in the BPO and customer experience industry. They have been instrumental in the growth and global expansion of our Company. They are supported by a skilled team that brings in operational, domain, financial, and legal expertise.
